text: Light takes about 1.3 seconds to travel from the Moon to Earth.
Sunlight takes about 8 minutes and 20 seconds to reach Earth.
A day on Venus is longer than its year.
Neptune takes about 165 Earth years to orbit the Sun.
The Moon is slowly moving away from Earth by about 3.8 centimeters per year.
One million Earths could fit inside the Sun by volume, approximately.
